page.layout: One column of running text on a single printed page. No marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Catchword "cau-" at the bottom right, below the last line.

main_text.p: stator, quærebatur, an eo testamento neposinstitutus esset, cum itascriptũ fuisset, QVI SVVS NASCETVR. Respondetur: Si ius omne antiquum spectemus, nõ est institutus: rumpeturq; testamentum, quasi nepote præterito. sed quia secundum legis Velleę caput uetat propterea testamentum rumpi, iubetq; formulam illam sic accipi, qua si uerba CVM NASCETVR adiecta nõ essent, propterea omnis tollitur dubitatio. Ex his igitur quàm bene uerba se Velleæ legis habeant, sed quàm commodè scripta sit, apparet: huiusq; secundi capitis utilitas elucet, quæ triplex est. Prima, ne nominatim nepotem, pronepotem, abnepotem appellare opus sit: sed generaliuerbo utí possimus, QVI SVVS NASCETVR, id est, erit. Secunda, ne casus omnes quibus e familia emigratur, enumerare ne cesse sit, si MORIATVR, si emancipe-tur, si deportetur, si ab hostibus capiatur: quos supplendos in C. Aquilij for-mula diximus. quam tamẽ utilitatem aut nullam, aut pertenuẽ esse, superius ex eo demonstrauimus, quòd in pari

page.notes: Long s is transcribed as plain s. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed ("emancipe-tur", "for-mula", "cau-"). The catchword "cau-" is at the foot of the page and is not repeated in the text. "Velleę" is printed this way and is kept as is. Printed text is not normalised beyond the u/v and i/j rules.
